description: Water level has reached knee height (approx 1.5 ft) on the riverside lane. Small cars cannot pass.
Minor water accumulation near the footpath drain, two-wheelers can pass cautiously.
Traffic crawl due to 6-inch water puddles near bridge ramp.
Manhole cover dislodged due to storm water pressure.
Branch fell on side lane, PMC garden dept notified, single lane slow.
